<thought>We need to find a template for a nucleophilic aromatic substitution (S_NAr) where a halide is replaced by an amine. The functional group broken is "halide" and the functional group formed is an amine, which in the available list corresponds to "primary amines", "secondary amines", or "tertiary amines". We'll search the template catalog using these criteria and the given molecule SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc([N+](=O)[O-])cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1S(=O)(=O)Nc1ccccc1F",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
